}}'''Turanna Norill''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Turanna Norill}}

== Appearance and Abilities ==
Turanna is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|32}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of [[Dumai's Wells]] by the [[Asha'man]].{{ref/book|6|55}}

Turanna was one of the captured Aes Sedai to be interrogated by [[Verin Mathwin]] in order to discover the White Tower's intentions towards [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|7|1}}{{ref/book|8|p}} In reality Verin used her mild [[Compulsion]] to implant in their minds some instructions about Rand.

Later it is reported by [[Sorilea]] that she along with the rest of the Aes Sedai prisoners have sworn fealty to Rand.{{ref/book|9|13}}

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Turanna probably fought the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]].{{ref/book|14|34}} It is not stated whether she survived or not.
